digest.component_or_area: review-bot persistent tickets clone and deployment automation
propositions: A redeploy does not refresh the persistent tickets clone on EBS because the generated entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, leaving divergent history intact across deployments.

The entrypoint invokes reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT block, so convergence must run even when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset, but the current script does not fetch, classify ancestry, or reset divergent clones.
The autodeploy.sh script omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS, preventing changes to the ensure script from triggering a deploy and delivery to the box.
Convergence failure must remain best-effort and never undo or wedge an already-cast vote; store write errors are caught after post_vote in artifact_emit.py.

A pre-epoch persistent clone with a local tip that is an ancestor of the prior readable remote tip should adopt the newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit, but local-ahead, diverged, or ambiguous states must preserve the exact local tip and warn the operator.
